newsitem.title: USA: Appalachian Power files $75 mln debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Appalachian Power files $75 mln debt shelf.

text.p: Appalachian Power said Thursday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $75 million of junior subordinated debentures.

Proceeds will be used to purchase indirectly cumulative preferred stock, to fund construction programs or to repay short-term indebtedness incurred in connection with such purchase or its construction program.

Appalachian Power is engaged in the generation, purchase, transmission and distribution of electric power to about 865,000 customers in Virginia and West Virginia and in suppling electric power at wholesale to other electric utility companies and municipalities in those states and Tennessee.
Appalachian, based in Roanoke, Va., is a unit of American Electric Power Co Inc.
